description: What only the owner can do, added by agents: context, a checklist, answered questions and an optional question for the owner. Shown in Notes › For you and by `python -m services.atlas.actions`. Ticks, the owner's input and 'done' are stored locally and never change this file. Remove an item once it is settled. Never put secret values here.

actions.title: Review and release the weekly build (synthetic example)
actions.context: Synthetic demo item. Agents finished three tasks this week on their own branches; the tests passed and pull requests are open. Only the owner merges.

steps.text: Read the three open pull requests
steps.detail: Each pull request links its evidence file with the exact checks that ran.
The updater installs merged work by itself; rejected work goes back to the plan.
Only needed when the service itself changed.
